title: coons_cage prompt: clarify cube size vs extent for scaling to reference
description: Role-play session got the scale wrong: multiplied by half the reference extent instead of the full extent, producing a mesh at half scale. A cube(size=1.0) has extent 1.0 (vertices at plus/minus 0.5), so the correct scale-to-reference is scale equal to the reference extents, not half. This is not obvious from the catalog. Fix: add a one-liner to coons_cage or DSL_PITFALL_WARNINGS stating that cube(size=1.0) has extent 1.0 and transform_geometry scale should equal the reference bounding-box extent, not half of it.
definition-of-done: 1. Pitfall line added to DSL_PITFALL_WARNINGS or coons_cage technique prompt. 2. Next interactive session hits the expected scale on first try.
testing-plan: 1. Re-run be-voyage-agent against the skull reference; confirm the first transform_geometry scale matches the reference bounding-box extents without needing correction.
